title: A remote erase landing while the Settings sheet is up may leave firstRun set with no onboarding cover shown
evidence: needs a look: PR 1602 (d5db9e3db) made the first-run cover one Cover union (App/FirstRun.swift; FirstRunTests names S16), and an erase now moves it to questions(.afterErase) whatever sheet is up; whether a fullScreenCover set while the Settings sheet is up shows once the sheet closes needs a device run, not source. RootView.swift:100-107, :205-209. RootView.recordChanged sets firstRun when erasedElsewhere, but the full-screen onboarding cover belongs to TabView, and SwiftUI may not present it while a child sheet (Settings) is up; firstRun then stays set with nothing on screen, blocking recordChanged and offerCloud until relaunch (onboarded is false, so a relaunch heals it). Predates PR 1284; PR 1284's holdLifts recheck adds one more moment it can happen (a local erase ending refused while a remote erase landed). Rare, not seen on a device. Remedy if wanted: when a remote erase lands with Settings up, wait for the sheet to close before restarting. Found by the PR 1284 re-check (adversary R2), RootView.swift ~:117, DataEraser.swift ~:111.
